name: Legacy review

subjectOf.text: The more hierarchical the code review process and the more barriers to entry it imposes, the lower the quality of the resulting code.
subjectOf.abstract: In other words, the more hierarchical the code review process and the more barriers to entry, the lower the quality of code.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: legacy code review firms with hierarchical reviewer selection

subjectOf.text: In hierarchical legacy review processes the first reviewer's output gets the highest priority and follow on reviewers add only minor upgrades, so the collective of reviewers is not incentivized to find flaws and optimize the code as a collective work product.
